title: SQLite foreign-key enforcement must be enabled on every connection
problem: Deleting a parent row left orphan child rows even though the schema declared ON DELETE CASCADE.
cause: PRAGMA foreign_keys was enabled only on the migration connection. SQLite foreign-key enforcement is disabled by default and scoped to each connection, so later application connections did not enforce the cascade.
fix: Centralized connection creation and executed PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON for every newly opened connection.
prevention: Route every database open through one connection factory and test both PRAGMA foreign_keys and cascade behavior on an ordinary runtime connection.
